claims.claim_text: FrankenEngine is a native Rust runtime for adversarial extension workloads with deterministic replay, cryptographic decision receipts, and fleet-scale containment.

source_span.must_contain: Native Rust runtime for adversarial extension workloads

claims.verification_command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/data/projects/franken_engine/target_<agent> CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS="-C linker=cc" cargo check -p frankenengine-engine --tests
claims.reason: Native runtime source and focused compile evidence were checked during the GA proof audit; full release gates remain separate.
claims.downgrade_text: Native Rust runtime target with deterministic replay and evidence-led containment under active verification.

claims.reason: Live guardplane decision example (bd-1ypps) generates actual posterior computation and expected-loss decision artifacts with smoke test validation.
